_comment: Copy this file, replace the entries with real places you have verified,
and delete these _comment keys (they are ignored, but they are noise).
Only factual details belong here: name, address, rent, size, coordinates.
There is deliberately no way to add reviews through this importer -- an
invented review about a real, findable landlord is a legal problem you do
not want. Reviews come from real tenants or not at all.
Re-running the import updates listings matched on school + address rather
than creating duplicates, so you can add places a few at a time.
Use --dry-run to validate without writing anything.

owner._comment: Optional. The account bulk-imported listings are attributed to.
owner.name: CampusNest

listings._comment: Every field below except lat/lng/images is required.
listings.title: Name of the building or PG as people actually call it
listings.school: The college students would search for
listings.description: At least 20 characters. Stick to facts you can verify: what is included in rent, how far the walk is, parking, water supply, gate timings.
listings._comment_coords: Optional, but a listing without them never shows on the map. Right-click the building on openstreetmap.org and choose 'Show address'.
listings._comment_images: Optional. Absolute https URLs only, max 5. Use photos you took or have permission to use -- not results from an image search.

listings.title: Second example — studio with no coordinates
listings.address: Some Road, Some Area, Some City 000000
listings.school: The college students would search for
listings.description: Leaving lat and lng out is fine. The listing works normally, it simply will not appear on the map view.
